description: Returns all Telegram personal accounts and group chats linked to the Statuser account with their settings: chat id, type, username, avatar, 2FA flag, selected topic and available topics for supergroup-forum groups. A non-null `disabled_reason` means the messenger refuses delivery to this chat (`bot_blocked`, `user_deactivated`, `chat_not_found`, `bot_kicked`, `no_rights`): no notifications go there. It is fixed in the messenger and confirmed by a channel test in the Statuser panel.
name: telegram_linked_list
title: List linked Telegram chats
